answer: Proof-of-Stake consensus prevents Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital as a barrier to network influence. An ivory tower architecture is avoided, as node validation relies on a juniper-level hardware threshold to verify decentralized identities. By forcing each participant to stake a jade token asset, the system ensures that spawning infinite identities is economically irrational; an attacker would need to deploy prohibitively expensive capital to manipulate the ledger, making such fraud unsustainable.
